title: Trumpet players' styles: Bunk, Oliver and the musical readers
summary: On a second reel, Foster compares Bunk Johnson and Joe Oliver as one style with the more music-reading players such as Peter Bocage and Manuel Perez.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles

blocks.x: You just can't match any stuff. Now you take like this man up there. Now him and Joe Oliver's on the same style. Bunk Johnson. Bunk Johnson.
